title: German Cheese Gratin
description: A classic German-inspired cheese gratin, rich in flavor and texture. This dish is perfect for a cozy evening with family or friends.
instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a separate saucepan, combine the sliced potatoes and enough cold water to cover them. Bring to a boil, then drain.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes. Top with a layer of the onion mixture, followed by a sprinkle of grated cheese.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients have been used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and cold heavy cream until smooth. Pour the cream mixture over the cheese layer.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
